request: Rank the 4 best Dodge Challenger generations overall across the full production run. Use 4 different generations when available, with one representative version from each generation. If the model has fewer than 4 true generations, use the most important era-defining versions across its history.
title: RANKING THE BEST DODGE CHALLENGER GENERATIONS
close_narration: Which generation of Dodge Challenger would you take for a spin—the classic R/T, or one of the mighty Demons?
order_rationale: Ranked by weighted enthusiast desirability, driving engagement, historical significance, performance, collectibility, and value—not chronology.

entries.name: Third Generation SRT Hellcat
entries.label: MODERN POWERHOUSE
entries.one_line_fact: Let's kick off with the Third Generation SRT Hellcat, a modern powerhouse. Launched in 2015 with 707 horsepower, it roared onto the scene sporting Hellcat badging and those unmistakable dual hood scoops.
entries.ranking_case: The 2015 SRT Hellcat's unprecedented 707 hp brought the Challenger back to the forefront of the muscle car wars.

entries.name: First Generation R/T
entries.label: THE ORIGINAL MUSCLE
entries.one_line_fact: Next up, the legendary First Generation R/T from 1970. With its 425-hp HEMI V8 and an original price of just $3,125, it defined the muscle car era. Its iconic quad headlights and chrome grille still turn heads.
entries.ranking_case: The 1970 Challenger R/T, with its iconic design and powerful 426 HEMI, epitomizes the golden age of muscle cars.

entries.name: Third Generation SRT Demon 170
entries.label: FINAL BOSS
entries.one_line_fact: Then, we reached the pinnacle with the Third Generation SRT Demon 170, debuting in 2023. Packing 1,025 horsepower, it improved performance but lost some raw character along the way. Originally priced at $100,361, it’s the ultimate modern Challenger.
entries.ranking_case: The 2023 SRT Demon 170's 1,025 hp represents the ultimate expression of the Challenger's muscle car legacy.

entries.label: DRAG STRIP KING
entries.one_line_fact: And finally, the Third Generation SRT Demon takes the crown. Introduced in 2018, this drag strip king with 840 horsepower redefined track performance. Priced at $84,995, it's a collectible icon with serious muscle and ageless allure.
